brief.intent: Vela Field Notes is an authored alternative for the same training journal: warm paper, charcoal and terracotta; smaller editorial hierarchy, compact ruled grouping, shallow corners, short low-overshoot motion. Preserve all six screens, state, text enlargement and reduced motion. These are editable brief preferences, not human preference evidence.

states.purpose: Understand readiness and choose one purposeful session
Inspect an interval session before committing
Run, pause, resume and finish a local training timer
Release effort and record the completed local session
Review clearly labeled sample history and local completed sessions

requirements: Test scenarios are samples, not viewport admission limits; positive runtime dimensions reflow through the identity-bound input domain.
Preserve readable content and scroll access; use inline actions when a fixed dock would consume the viewport.
Use resolved region bindings and transition topology, not hardcoded replacement geometry
Maintain natural text heights, 44pt minimum iOS control targets and safe areas
Native font scaling stays enabled; reflow topology changes with text scale
Reduced motion substitutes a short opacity transition with no spatial movement
Final rendering and task proofs required before accepted status
